name: opencli-adapter-author
tagline_zh: 写字的人会喜欢：opencli-adapter-author。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Use when writing an OpenCLI adapter for a new site or adding a new command to an existing site. Guides end-to-end from first recon through field decoding, adapter coding, and verify. Replaces opencli-oneshot / opencli-explorer. For ad-hoc browser driving (no adapter), see opencli-browser instead; for a top-level orientation to opencli, see opencli-usage.
